verdict.rationale: Docs and the open-source repo confirm Skills are plain folders containing a SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter and instructions, not a proprietary binary — an independently observed runtime probe even shows third-party tooling (npx skills add) fetching and installing a skill from the repo into a generic .claude/skills/ dir with clean, spec-conformant markdown, and a public spec (agentskills.io) exists for the format. missing for 10: no direct hands-on evidence of carrying the same SKILL.md into a fully different, non-Anthropic harness (e.g., a competitor agent) and confirming it works there unmodified.
